results.title: LT Foods Q2 Results: Net profit rises 10% on 17% revenue growth; margin falls
results.description: LT Foods reported a 9.9% YoY increase in net profit to ₹180 crore for the second quarter, while revenue rose 16.8% to ₹3,231 crore. EBITDA grew 8.7% to ₹336 crore, while EBITDA margin declined to 10.4% from 11.2% a year ago.

results.title: Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Series India Launch Date Announced Along With Key Specifications, Colour Options
results.description: Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Series will be launched in India on November 5 at 12 pm IST, the company announced on Tuesday. The company has also announced that the Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Series will be available for purchase in India in Arctic Blue, Komodo Coral, and Zabriskie Beige colour options.
